title: TOHSENO ShotRegistry generation 0.8 permissionless commitment preimage
$comment: This preimage is not signed. Keccak-256(abi.encode(typeHash, controller, shotId, salt, registry, chainId, deadline)) is submitted permissionlessly; the later REGISTER_SHOT reveal is controller-signed. Solidity accepts any bytes32 salt. TOHSENO publication clients require a freshly generated, privately persisted CSPRNG salt.
